title: Scholia Bobiensia in Ciceronis orationes — Bobbio scholia on Cicero's speeches; Боббиенские схолии к речам Цицерона. Proposed unit: Pro Sestio + In Vatinium
author: Anonymous ('Bobbio scholiast')
date: Late antique commentary in a Bobbio palimpsest
edition: Stangl, Ciceronis orationum scholiastae, 1912 (public domain; Stangl d. 1921). Same volume has ps.-Asconius
ru_evidence: No translation found; the ancientrome.ru catalogue has Asconius only
en_evidence: attalus.org: excerpts from 11 speeches, incl. all introductions (est. ~15k words)
value: Preserves context and fragments of lost Cicero speeches (In Clodium et Curionem, De aere alieno Milonis, De rege Alexandrino) and data on late-Republican politics. Essential for historians of the 60s–50s BCE
ai_feasibility: high — clear prose; gaps in the palimpsest must be marked
pilot_unit: Scholia on Pro Sestio + In Vatinium (est. 8–10k words); extend to the whole corpus with ps.-Asconius
